keyPoints.en: Financial management process: set goals → evaluate financial status → create a plan → carry it out → review and revise.
keyPoints.bm: Proses pengurusan kewangan: tetapkan matlamat → nilai status kewangan → wujudkan pelan → laksanakan → kaji semula dan semak.

keyPoints.en: SMART goals: Specific, Measurable, Attainable, Realistic, Time-bound. Short-term (< 1 year) or long-term (> 5 years).
keyPoints.bm: Matlamat SMART: Spesifik, boleh diukur, boleh dicapai, realistik, tempoh masa. Jangka pendek (< 1 tahun) atau jangka panjang (> 5 tahun).

keyPoints.en: Income: active (salary, wages) and passive (rent, dividends, interest).
keyPoints.bm: Pendapatan: aktif (gaji, upah) dan pasif (sewa, dividen, faedah).

keyPoints.en: Expenses: fixed (rent, loans, insurance, savings) and variable (food, petrol, utilities, entertainment).
keyPoints.bm: Perbelanjaan: tetap (sewa, pinjaman, insurans, simpanan) dan tidak tetap (makanan, petrol, utiliti, hiburan).

keyPoints.en: Cash flow = income − expenses. Surplus → save or invest; deficit → cut variable expenses or raise income.
keyPoints.bm: Aliran tunai = pendapatan − perbelanjaan. Lebihan → simpan atau labur; defisit → kurangkan perbelanjaan tidak tetap atau tambah pendapatan.

keyPoints.en: 'Pay yourself first': put at least 10% of income into savings as a fixed expense.
keyPoints.bm: 'Bayar diri sendiri dahulu': masukkan sekurang-kurangnya 10% pendapatan ke dalam simpanan sebagai perbelanjaan tetap.

question.en: Income RM2500, fixed RM1200, variable RM900. Goal: RM6000 in 12 months. Achievable?
question.bm: Pendapatan RM2500, tetap RM1200, tidak tetap RM900. Matlamat: RM6000 dalam 12 bulan. Boleh dicapai?

answer.en: Surplus RM400 but needs RM500/month → cut RM100 of variable expenses or take 15 months
answer.bm: Lebihan RM400 tetapi perlu RM500/bulan → kurangkan RM100 perbelanjaan tidak tetap atau ambil 15 bulan

tip.en: When asked if a goal is achievable, always compare the monthly amount needed with the monthly surplus.
tip.bm: Apabila ditanya sama ada matlamat boleh dicapai, sentiasa bandingkan jumlah bulanan diperlukan dengan lebihan bulanan.
